shared_memory_governor.static_review: No additional correctness blocker found in the reviewed single training thread plus one producer topology.
shared_memory_governor.admission: Actual process RSS plus all outstanding phase reservations plus proposed reservation must fit the unchanged cap. Eviction rechecks actual RSS; charged bytes are not assumed physically released.
shared_memory_governor.concurrency: Condition with reentrant lock serializes cache mutations, weakref expiration, release, snapshots and phase eviction. Pending cache key is protected before an admission wait; active executor leases are never evicted. Condition waiting releases the recursive lock and allows other-owner phase completion. A nested reservation with no other active owner fails rather than waiting on itself.
shared_memory_governor.pool_order: The original pool starts no producer work during construction. Replacement governor is installed before prefetch. load waits for producer completion before restore admission. Training admission precedes labels and next-parent prefetch. Preparation holds its own reservation through lossless packing. No reviewed direct lock-order cycle was found.
shared_memory_governor.cache_admission: Cold-build estimate plus16MiB or existing-bind64*holds plus16MiB is reserved for the complete base acquire. Base callbacks may only request within that allowance. Memory remains bounded by explicit cache accounting and actual RSS checks.
shared_memory_governor.limits: These are conservative operational reserves with sampled RSS enforcement, not a mathematical allocator peak proof. Eviction can fail to reduce actual RSS; failure remains explicit and never reduces the parent or changes execution mode.
